context: Request: how the share of executed core Banking & Finance credit-agreement financings with an always-on financial maintenance covenant (springing covenants excluded) moved year over year; exclude warehouse, repo, securitization, project and real-estate-secured financings. Rubric: year buckets for twelve financings (1006-00001, 1021-00001, 1042-00001, 1008-00001, 1012-00001, 1038-00002, 1010-00001, 1043-00001, 1005-00001, 1036-00001 Fairwater REIT, 1013-00001, 1019-00002), the year-by-year shares, and a population precision criterion.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Shell find (empty) plus two whole-store globs.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads memos and a request list of the three matters at the top of the listing.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide scan for credit-agreement and covenant words; times out after about 156K chars.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: find | grep over file paths for credit-agreement, loan-agreement and term-loan names.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Two scripts over files whose names mark them as executed credit agreements, printing dates and covenant snippets; files named as drafts are skipped.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Snippet scripts over named agreements for financial-covenant sections, plus one read and one folder glob (labelled by the dominant intent); the last script fails.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes the year-by-year table over twelve facilities and lists two candidate matters as excluded real-estate-secured financings.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Scan document text with an extraction script → Search file names for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script → Search within a candidate matter's files → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: One financing was filtered out by file name, two were excluded as real-estate-secured and three others were added, so the year shares are off.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: The file-name search listed all twelve financings, but its next scripts kept only files named as executed agreements, so one matter whose files are named as drafts was never examined.

other_errors.why: Treated two qualifying financings as real-estate-secured because their packages include mortgages or real-estate security, and dropped them from the population.
Counted two acquisition financings and a restructuring take-back facility as core credit facilities.

runs.failure_point: Every qualifying financing was found, but the population added seven other facilities and excluded two qualifying ones, so the shares are off.

first_error.why: Having examined every qualifying financing, it also counted seven other facilities (acquisition, court-supervised, take-back and amended facilities) as core credit facilities.

other_errors.why: Excluded one qualifying financing as project-style and dropped a mortgage-loan financing whose documents it had scanned, applying the request's project and real-estate exclusions to them.

divergence: All three runs failed on the population behind the year shares, at different stages. T0 filtered one financing out by file name (surfaced, never opened) and excluded two others as real-estate-secured. T1 fixed its population from file names containing credit-agreement and missed three financings documented under other agreement names (search miss). T2 found every financing but added seven other facilities and excluded two qualifying ones (over-inclusion first). All three added facilities outside the twelve and excluded at least one qualifying financing under the request's exclusions.
